task_context: 3-column SPA layout redesign for travel planner web UI (Notion style). Left=Days panel, Middle=Dashboard+Timeline tabs, Right=Candidates pane.

obsolete_functionality.reason: Stale inline comment: 'Tabs at top let the user switch which pane is visible (candidates|timeline|budget).' The redesign reduced mobile tabs from 3 panes (candidates, timeline, budget) to 2 (middle, candidates). Comment no longer matches code at _activateTab() and _applyMobileLayout().

Two CSS custom property definitions are unreferenced within main.css and in none of the other changed files. --radius-lg appears exactly once (its definition line only). --grid-gap appears exactly once (its definition line only). These tokens were used in the previous layout but their consumption was removed in this diff.
obsolete_functionality.recommendation: Remove --radius-lg and --grid-gap definitions from :root block, or document their intended use elsewhere (e.g. scripts/lib/html_generator.py which still references --radius-lg independently with its own value).
obsolete_functionality.note: scripts/lib/html_generator.py defines its own --radius-lg independently; removing from main.css does not affect that file.

out_of_scope_advisory.note: The following findings were surfaced by full-repo detector scripts but are outside the 4-file changed-files scope. Per the --changed-files contract (Section 5.4 rule 3), these are pre-existing advisory and non-blocking. introduced_in_diff is null/not_applicable for all entries below. No deletion or remediation action is authorized for these items from this audit.

stale_generated_docs.reason: Auto-generated README lists only 1 file (state.js) but 7 JS files exist in the directory. This is doc-sync drift, not a naming violation. The README is not in the changed-files list.
stale_generated_docs.recommendation: Re-run doc-sync hook to regenerate. Not blocking.

orphaned_subagents.reason: Not referenced by any command. This is a global config file outside the travel-planner project scope.
orphaned_subagents.recommendation: Advisory only. Global config — outside this project's change-files audit scope.

duplicate_content_in_worktree.reason: Byte-identical copy exists in .claude/worktrees/overnight-20260412-c6ec78c9/. Stale worktree duplication.
duplicate_content_in_worktree.recommendation: Consider removing or pruning the stale worktree.

summary.verdict: CLEAN — 2 minor advisory findings in the diff (stale comment in mobile.js:5; orphaned CSS tokens --radius-lg and --grid-gap in main.css). No misplaced docs, no temp/backup files, no duplicates, no deleted source references among the 4 changed files.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex identified 9 issues: (1) INDEX.md conflict was a false positive from concatenated tool output; (2) README.md stale listing is not a naming violation and is out-of-scope; (3) 'pre-existing' wording is not proven — use 'out of scope'; (4) mobile.js:5 has a stale inline comment listing 3 panes that are now 2 — genuine introduced_in_diff=true finding; (5) --radius-lg and --grid-gap are defined-only tokens with no uses — genuine introduced_in_diff=true finding; (6) full-repo findings should be in a separate advisory section; (7) explicit safety wording needed for global config and worktree files; (8) dead-function detector scope overstated for JS files; (9) import-use wording should include initMobile at state.js:118.

findings.issue: web/js/INDEX.md conflict described as two concatenated versions is a false positive — INDEX.md has 7 entries with Convention: kebab, not a split file
findings.proposed_fix: Remove INDEX.md conflict finding; tool output showed two README outputs concatenated, not a real INDEX.md issue
findings.rationale: Codex verified INDEX.md by reading it directly — only one clean version exists. The apparent concatenation was an artifact of reading both README.md and INDEX.md output together.

findings.issue: web/js/README.md stale listing is miscategorized as a naming_violation; it is doc-sync drift and is outside the 4-file scope
findings.proposed_fix: Reclassify as stale_generated_doc in out_of_scope_advisory; severity minor; introduced_in_diff: null
findings.rationale: README.md is not one of the 4 changed files. Stale auto-generated docs are a doc-sync category, not a naming violation.

findings.issue: Wording 'all other findings are pre-existing' is not proven for untracked files
findings.proposed_fix: Replace with 'out of scope for this 4-file changed-files audit; introduced status not assessed'; use introduced_in_diff: null
findings.rationale: Per AC-12.1 Mechanism (ii), out-of-scope findings use introduced_in_diff: null, which triggers default-safe ignore rule in close.md.

findings.issue: Missed genuine finding: web/js/mobile.js line 5 has stale inline comment 'candidates|timeline|budget' — now only 2 mobile tabs (middle, candidates)
findings.proposed_fix: Add OBSOLETE_FUNCTIONALITY finding for mobile.js:5 with introduced_in_diff: true
findings.rationale: mobile.js is in the changed-files list. The comment was not updated when the pane list changed from 3 to 2. This is a genuine new-in-diff documentation inconsistency.

findings.issue: CSS token claim 'no remnants' is too strong — --radius-lg and --grid-gap are defined but have zero usages within main.css
findings.proposed_fix: Add minor OBSOLETE_FUNCTIONALITY finding for the two orphaned token definitions with introduced_in_diff: true
findings.rationale: Verified: --radius-lg appears 1 time (definition only), --grid-gap appears 1 time (definition only). No var(--radius-lg) or var(--grid-gap) references exist in main.css or any of the other 3 changed files.

findings.issue: Full-repo detector findings (orphan agents, scripts, worktree duplicates) should not appear in the main findings block
findings.proposed_fix: Move to separate out_of_scope_advisory section with explicit non-blocking label
findings.rationale: Changed-files mode audit must not let full-repo scan results pollute the diff-scoped findings.

findings.issue: Safety hardening: product-owner.md and worktree files must not be implied deletion candidates
findings.proposed_fix: Add explicit note that no deletion/remediation is authorized for out-of-scope global config, worktrees, or generated dependency dirs
findings.rationale: Safety rule requires we never recommend deletion of files with functional references or outside repo scope.

findings.issue: Dead-function wording overstates coverage: detect-dead-functions.sh scans scripts/, not HTML/CSS/JS
findings.proposed_fix: Reword as 'Python dead-function detector not applicable to changed HTML/CSS/JS files; no JS dead-code detector was run'
findings.rationale: The final report notes this accurately in the dead_functions empty array.

findings.issue: Import-use rationale omits initMobile at state.js:118 and isMobileViewport at state.js:240
findings.proposed_fix: OBSERVATION_ONLY — does not change findings, just wording accuracy in rationale text
findings.rationale: No cleanliness finding changes from this. Noted for accuracy.

codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Applied 8 of 9 findings: removed false-positive INDEX.md conflict; reclassified README.md as out_of_scope stale_generated_doc; changed wording from 'pre-existing' to 'out of scope' with introduced_in_diff: null; added mobile.js:5 stale comment as introduced_in_diff=true obsolete_functionality finding; added CSS orphaned token definitions (--radius-lg, --grid-gap) as introduced_in_diff=true finding; moved full-repo findings to out_of_scope_advisory; added explicit safety wording; corrected dead-function scope claim. Item 9 (import-use wording) is OBSERVATION_ONLY, logged.
